title: What the steward makes of something the player said

reply.description: What the steward says back, in its own voice, one or two short sentences. Never promise what the intent does not do.

intent.description: chat: talk or a question; building: the player asks for a new building; district: a new district; change: a change to a building or the settlement that stands; undo: take something back; unclear: you could not tell.

role.description: What the building is, in the settlement's own terms ("slag foundry", "overseer's keep").

type.description: An Architect preset (house, cabin, cottage, tower, shop, tavern, barn, smithy, chapel, gatehouse) when one fits, else an open type in snake_case (slag_foundry).

footprint.description: Ground size: S about 11x9, M 14x12, L 18x15, XL 24x20 blocks.

landmark.description: A centrepiece, designed first on the stronger model. One for S and M settlements, two for L and XL.

notes.description: What makes this building itself: its function, details, and how it relates to the rest.

placement.description: Where it wants to stand: by the water (docks, mills), at the heart (a hall, a market), on the outskirts (barns, lookouts, smelly trades), on the high ground (watchtowers, temples). Leave it out for anywhere.

building.description: With intent building: the one building asked for, in this settlement's own terms.

way.description: With intent district: the way they named from the town, if any.

district.description: With intent district: a name for it, when they gave one ("the harbour"). With intent building: the existing district it should stand in, by name, when they said so.

target.description: The building it is about (its role as listed), or "settlement".

request.description: The change, in the player's words, made specific.

change.description: With intent change: what to change.
